**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 74 **Archetype** [Thlipit Contestant](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=224) **Prerequisites** [Thlipit Contestant Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5474); Trained in [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) **Requirements** The target can’t be more than one size larger than you. --- You quickly wrap your lash around an opponent and pull them toward you. Attempt an [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) check against the Fortitude DC of a target within your lash's reach. **Special** If you have the [Titan Wrestler](/Feats.aspx?ID=5226) feat, you can target a creature up to two sizes larger than you, or up to three sizes larger than you if you’re legendary in [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36). **Critical Success** You [pull](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) the target to any open space adjacent to you.
**Success** You pull the target to the nearest open space adjacent to you.
**Critical Failure** You misjudge your leverage and fall [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88).
